tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List Google Business Profile locations owned by the authenticated GBP Master account. Use this before a location-scoped tool.

tools.name: generate_local_rank_report
tools.description: Measure the selected connected business's actual position for one keyword within the first 11 Google local results using SerpApi. Before calling, show the keyword and location and obtain explicit user confirmation. Supply a new request_id and reuse it if retrying the same confirmed scan to prevent duplicate provider requests. The result includes a temporary downloadable PDF link at no additional charge.

tools.name: list_business_accounts
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Google Business Profile accounts and location counts.

tools.name: get_account_overview
tools.description: Return the account plan, connected account and location totals, review automation count, and scheduled campaign count.

tools.name: list_review_automation_rules
tools.description: List account-default and location-specific review reply automation rules. This is a read-only action.

tools.name: configure_review_automation_rule
tools.description: Create or replace the account-default rule or one location override. Enabling auto_publish authorizes future public Google replies, so call only after the user confirms the target, rating range, instructions, limits and publishing mode.

tools.name: list_content_campaigns
tools.description: List account-level campaigns and every targeted GBP location. This is a read-only action.

tools.name: create_content_campaign
tools.description: Create a free draft for one or more owned locations. This does not schedule, publish. EVENT and OFFER drafts require an event title and times.

tools.name: schedule_content_campaign
tools.description: Schedule an existing approved draft.  Call only after showing the complete campaign, every location and exact time, and obtaining confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_content_campaign
tools.description: Cancel a draft or scheduled campaign after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: list_review_reply_jobs
tools.description: List generated review reply drafts, approvals, scheduled replies and delivery results. This is a read-only action.

tools.name: approve_review_reply_job
tools.description: Approve the exact stored reply text for publication now or at a supplied time. Call only after showing the user the draft, target review and publication time, and obtaining confirmation.

tools.name: cancel_review_reply_job
tools.description: Cancel a draft, pending, scheduled or failed review reply.

tools.name: list_media_assets
tools.description: List reusable photos and videos already uploaded to the authenticated account's media library. Use an asset ID when creating a content campaign.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews for one owned Google Business Profile location. Filter by whether a review has a reply. This is a read-only action.

tools.name: draft_review_reply
tools.description: Draft a reply for one unanswered review using the location's saved tone, keywords, and instructions. This does not publish.

tools.name: publish_review_reply
tools.description: Publish the exact supplied reply publicly on Google. Call only after the user has reviewed and explicitly confirmed the reply and target review.

tools.name: list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List calendar posts for one owned location. This is a read-only action.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule an approved text, photo, or video item for Google publication. Call only after the user explicitly confirms the location, content, exact time. Media must use a durable public HTTPS URL.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled_post
tools.description: Permanently remove one pending scheduled post. Call only after the user explicitly confirms cancellation.
